title: Zoho Analytics API Vocabulary
description: Terms, schemas, and operations vocabulary extracted from the Zoho Analytics OpenAPI specifications

ImportConfigNewTable.description: Configuration for importing data into a new table.

ExportConfig.description: Configuration for exporting data from a view using Bulk Export APIs.

BulkImportConfigNewTable.description: Configuration for importing data into a new table.

ImportJobConfigNewTable.description: Configuration for creating an asynchronous import job into a new table.

ImportJobConfigExistingTable.description: Configuration for creating an asynchronous import job into an existing table.

ExportJobDetailsResponse.description: Response for checking the status of an export job.

AddRowConfig.description: JSONObject with configuration for adding a row.

DeleteRowsConfig.description: JSONObject with configuration for deleting rows. Must contain exactly one of the following properties: `criteria` (for selective deletion based on a string expression) or `deleteAllRows` (a boolean to indicate deletion of all rows).

UpdateRowsConfig.description: JSONObject with configuration for updating rows.

CreateSimilarViewsConfig.description: Configuration for creating similar views based on a reference view.

ShareViewsResponse.description: Empty response with HTTP 204 No Content

RemoveShareResponse.description: Empty response with HTTP 204 No Content

batchImportNewTable.summary: Batch Import Data into New Table

batchImportExistingTable.summary: Batch Import Data into Existing Table

createExportJobSQLQuery.summary: Create Export Job using SQL Query (Asynchronous)

createImportJobNewTable.summary: Create Import Job for a New Table (Asynchronous)
